Wyrażenie „wziąć coś pod uwagę” pojawiło się w liście od organizatora konkursu. Czy mogę na tej podstawie uznać, że przyznano mi dodatkowe punkty?

Nie. „Wziąć coś pod uwagę” oznacza uwzględnić dany czynnik przy rozważaniu sprawy. Nie informuje jeszcze, jak ten czynnik wpłynął na ostateczny wynik ani czy przyznano punkty. Jeśli potrzebujesz potwierdzenia, zapytaj: „Czy uwzględnienie tej informacji zmieniło moją punktację? Jeśli tak, o ile?”. Odpowiedź powinna odróżniać sam proces oceny od jego liczbowego rezultatu.
A balloon filled with ordinary air is moved from a warm room into a colder one. It appears smaller even though its surface is intact. What explanation is consistent with gas laws?

Cooling reduces the average molecular kinetic energy. For a flexible balloon whose internal pressure remains close to ambient pressure, lower absolute temperature can correspond to a lower gas volume at roughly constant amount of gas, as described by the ideal gas law. The elastic tension of the balloon also affects pressure and volume, so an exact proportionality may not hold. Shrinkage alone does not establish a leak; warming back under comparable conditions can help test reversibility.
Create a short welcome message for a beginner's drawing class that explicitly allows participants to make imperfect drawings but does not promise that the class will be effortless.

Welcome! This class is a place to experiment with lines, shapes and observation, not a test of how well you can draw on the first try. Some exercises may feel challenging, and imperfect sketches are expected. Bring your curiosity, ask questions, and give yourself time to notice what changes with practice.
Ποια είναι η σημασία του «κατ' αρχάς» σε σχέση με το «κατ' αρχήν»; Θέλω να διατυπώσω μια πρώτη παρατήρηση σε έκθεση.

Στην προσεκτική χρήση, «κατ' αρχάς» σημαίνει «αρχικά» ή «πρώτα απ' όλα», ενώ «κατ' αρχήν» σημαίνει «ως προς τη βασική αρχή» ή «κατά βάση». Στην καθημερινή χρήση συχνά συγχέονται. Για την πρώτη παρατήρηση μιας έκθεσης, μπορείς να γράψεις απλά «Αρχικά, παρατηρούμε ότι...». Αν δηλώνεις συμφωνία επί της αρχής, χωρίς έγκριση όλων των λεπτομερειών, ταιριάζει το «Συμφωνούμε κατ' αρχήν».

A spreadsheet projects monthly savings by subtracting a person's usual monthly expenses from salary. It excludes an annual car insurance payment because it occurs only once a year. What adjustment would make the forecast more useful?

Include periodic expenses on the time scale appropriate to the decision. For an average monthly affordability estimate, set aside one twelfth of the annual premium each month, alongside other predictable irregular costs. For a bank-balance forecast, show the actual cash payment in the month it is due and any transfers to a reserve. The first view prevents a monthly surplus from ignoring a recurring obligation; the second reveals when cash will actually leave the account.

A program stores a decimal measurement in a JSON number. After decoding and encoding it, the original text `2.500` becomes `2.5`. Is the numeric value corrupted? What if the trailing zeros communicate instrument resolution?

Numerically those two representations are equal. A general JSON number does not guarantee preservation of its original spelling, and a parser may discard trailing zeros during serialization. If the zeros carry measurement significance, represent that information explicitly, for example through a decimal string together with units or a separate resolution field. Use numeric comparison for quantity equality and a separate rule for precision metadata. Do not expect formatting that is meaningful to a human to survive a representation that treats it as insignificant.

A friend has asked me to offer suggestions on their talk, but there is only an hour before they present it. I noticed several structural problems that would take a day to revise. How can I make feedback useful at this stage?

Prioritize changes they can make safely in the available time. Offer a clearer opening sentence, a brief transition or a cue for the conclusion rather than recommending a complete restructuring. Name larger issues only if they want ideas for a future revision. Ask whether they would prefer a quick rehearsal or two specific edits. Feedback should fit the time remaining; an accurate critique that leaves them trying to rebuild the talk moments before presenting may not serve their immediate goal.
“मुझे पुस्तक पढ़नी है” और “मुझे पुस्तक पढ़नी चाहिए” में आवश्यकता और सलाह का अंतर बताइए।

“मुझे पुस्तक पढ़नी है” संदर्भ के अनुसार पढ़ने की आवश्यकता, योजना या तय काम व्यक्त कर सकता है। “मुझे पुस्तक पढ़नी चाहिए” सामान्यतः सलाह, अपेक्षा या उचित समझी जाने वाली बात बताता है। उदाहरण: कल परीक्षा है, इसलिए मुझे पुस्तक पढ़नी है; इस विषय को बेहतर समझने के लिए मुझे पुस्तक पढ़नी चाहिए। वास्तविक बाध्यता कितनी है, यह परिस्थिति पर निर्भर करता है। दोनों वाक्य पढ़ लेने की पुष्टि नहीं करते।
I am told two positive numbers have product 36 and sum 13. Find the numbers by reasoning from factor pairs or an equation.

The factor pair 4 and 9 has product 36 and sum 13. To show this is the only unordered pair of real numbers, let one be x and the other 13-x. Then x(13-x)=36, or x^2-13x+36=0. Factoring gives (x-4)(x-9)=0, so either x=4 and the other is 9, or the reverse. The equation rules out additional real-valued pairs, not just other integer factors.

A health survey reports that people who own bicycles have fewer reported sick days than people who do not. Why might providing bicycles to everyone fail to reproduce the observed difference? Keep the discussion about study design rather than medical advice.

Ownership may reflect preexisting factors such as income, neighborhood infrastructure, work schedules, mobility or exercise habits. It does not establish whether a person actually cycles, and self-reported sick days can differ for reasons unrelated to cycling. To evaluate a provision program, define its target population, measure usage and outcomes consistently, and compare a suitable intervention and control group. The observed association can motivate research without establishing the effect of distributing bicycles.

A museum exhibit contains a photograph mounted beside a handwritten caption attributed to the photographer. The photograph's accession number is different from the caption's. How can the museum establish whether they originally belonged together?

Review accession documentation, provenance and mounting history, and compare the caption's content with identifiable features in the image. Look for earlier albums, correspondence or photographs of the display before remounting. Different accession numbers do not prove the items were unrelated, but adjacency in the current exhibit does not establish original association either. Preserve separate identifiers and record the relationship with a stated evidential basis until it can be confirmed.
Scrie un mesaj scurt prin care îi cer unui coleg să-mi confirme primirea unui document, fără a-i cere și aprobarea lui.
Bună, ți-am trimis documentul pentru întâlnirea de joi. Când ai ocazia, te rog să-mi confirmi doar că l-ai primit și că îl poți deschide. Nu este nevoie să îl aprobi în acest moment. Mulțumesc!

A shop starts the day with $180 cash in the till. It receives $462.80 in cash sales, pays $35.50 cash for supplies, and removes $400 to a safe. Use a calculator to find the expected closing till balance. The actual count is $205.30; compute the discrepancy as actual minus expected.

The expected balance is $207.30. With $205.30 physically counted, actual minus expected is negative $2.00, indicating a $2 shortage against the recorded cash movements. Check the transaction log, change given, and the safe transfer before drawing conclusions about its cause. A discrepancy is an observed difference, not evidence of a particular person's action.
Write a three-sentence description of a rainy city street from the perspective of an overhead security camera. Do not invent audible sounds or what pedestrians are thinking.

Umbrellas move along the pavement, their dark circles overlapping where the crossing narrows. The headlights of a stopped car stretch across a puddle in two white bands. Beside the bus shelter, a person in a pale coat waits under the edge of the roof.
Co znamená „podařilo se mi připojit“ oproti „zkoušel jsem se připojit“ při hlášení problému s internetem?

„Podařilo se mi připojit“ sděluje, že připojení bylo alespoň v určitém okamžiku úspěšné. „Zkoušel jsem se připojit“ popisuje pokus, ale samo o sobě neříká, zda vyšel. Pro technickou podporu je užitečné uvést i další stav: „Podařilo se mi připojit, ale po minutě se spojení přerušilo“ nebo „Zkoušel jsem se připojit třikrát, pokaždé bez úspěchu“. Tak lze oddělit pokus, dosažený výsledek a jeho trvání.

A small organization plans to reuse old office laptops for public training sessions. Staff have deleted their visible personal folders, and the machines appear empty. What should be done before handing them over?

Follow an approved device sanitization and reprovisioning process appropriate to the storage technology and data sensitivity. Ordinary deletion may leave recoverable content, cached credentials, browser profiles or synchronized files. Verify that organizational accounts and management profiles have been removed or replaced as intended, install a maintained training image, and create restricted participant accounts. Test the resulting devices without using former employees' credentials. Document the preparation and avoid handing over machines based solely on an empty desktop.

Two balls roll down ramps from the same vertical height. One ramp is steeper and shorter. Under ideal rolling without slipping, with identical balls and no losses, do the balls necessarily have different final speeds?

No. Each starts with the same gravitational potential energy relative to the bottom. With ideal rolling and identical rotational inertia, that energy becomes the same combination of translational and rotational kinetic energy at the bottom. The steep ramp can give a larger acceleration and a shorter descent time without changing the final speed. In a real setup, frictional losses, slipping, surface variations and transitions can change this result, so the ideal assumptions matter.

A Python decorator wraps a function and replaces its reported name with `wrapper`. This breaks generated documentation that relies on function metadata. What standard-library helper addresses the common case?

Use `functools.wraps(original_function)` on the wrapper. It copies commonly used metadata such as the original name and docstring and sets `__wrapped__` so introspection tools can locate the wrapped callable. It does not automatically fix every semantic difference or guarantee the wrapper accepts the original calling convention. Keep argument forwarding correct, and test documentation and signature introspection if they are part of your interface. The decorator should preserve the public contract intentionally.
Dans une annonce de spectacle, « à guichets fermés » signifie-t-il que le théâtre est fermé au public ? Comment l'expliquer à un apprenant ?

Non. Un spectacle « à guichets fermés » est un spectacle pour lequel toutes les places disponibles ont été vendues ou réservées : il est complet. Le public muni de billets peut bien sûr y assister si la représentation a lieu. L'expression ne décrit pas nécessairement les horaires d'ouverture de la billetterie. Pour une annonce plus accessible, « Toutes les places pour cette représentation sont réservées » évite la confusion avec une fermeture du bâtiment.
A runner increases their speed from 8 km/h to 10 km/h for the same distance. Someone claims their travel time decreases by 25% because the speed rose by 25%. Calculate the actual percentage decrease.

For fixed distance d, the old time is d/8 and the new time is d/10. Their ratio is (d/10)/(d/8)=8/10=0.8. The new time is 80% of the old time, a 20% reduction. Speed and travel time are inversely proportional at fixed distance, so a 25% speed increase does not imply an equal 25% time decrease. For example, a 40-minute trip at the old speed becomes 32 minutes.

A friend makes handmade cards and wants to sign both our names on the cards they send to mutual friends. I am happy to be included occasionally but want to approve messages that speak for me. What can we agree on?

Separate a shared greeting from words attributed to you. “I'd love to sign cards together when we've both seen the message. If you're sending something on your own, please sign your name, and you can let me know if you'd like me to add mine.” For routine cards you could agree on a simple shared phrase in advance. The aim is not to control what your friend writes, but to ensure a message presented as yours has your consent.
¿Qué significa «a falta de confirmar la fecha» en un programa de actividades? ¿Ya se ha cancelado la actividad?

Significa que queda pendiente la confirmación de la fecha. La actividad puede estar prevista, pero ese detalle todavía no está cerrado. No equivale a una cancelación ni garantiza que la actividad se celebrará exactamente como se anunció. Para un programa público, «Actividad prevista; fecha pendiente de confirmación» transmite el estado con claridad. Si existe una fecha provisional, indícala como tal en vez de presentarla como definitiva.

The recording duration is not yet verified. Keys recording_id, original, derivative, duration_seconds. original contains channels, sample_rate_hz, bit_depth; derivative contains channels, created_on. Use channel counts and null for duration; do not copy unspecified derivative settings.
{"recording_id":"S8","original":{"channels":1,"sample_rate_hz":48000,"bit_depth":24},"derivative":{"channels":2,"created_on":"2027-06-14"},"duration_seconds":null}

Two weather stations report rainfall for the same month. Station A recorded 90 mm over 30 days; station B recorded 70 mm but was offline for seven days. Can the raw totals establish that A was wetter?

The 70 mm is an observed subtotal for B's available days, not necessarily its complete monthly total. Rain during the missing days may narrow or reverse the difference. Compare totals over the common observation dates for a restricted comparison, or estimate the missing rainfall using a documented method and nearby reliable data with uncertainty. Report completeness for each station. Without knowing the missing observations, the raw totals alone cannot establish the ordering of full-month rainfall.
Was bedeutet „Das kommt darauf an“ in einer Beratung? Wie kann ich die Antwort so ergänzen, dass sie nicht wie ein Ausweichen wirkt?

Die Wendung signalisiert, dass die Antwort von bestimmten Bedingungen abhängt. Sie ist besonders hilfreich, wenn man diese Bedingungen auch nennt: „Das kommt darauf an, ob Sie das Gerät täglich oder nur gelegentlich benutzen. Bei täglicher Nutzung würde ich auf die Reparierbarkeit achten; bei gelegentlicher Nutzung ist möglicherweise ein einfacheres Modell ausreichend.“ So wird aus einer offenen Antwort eine nachvollziehbare Entscheidungshilfe. Ohne die entscheidenden Faktoren kann die Formulierung tatsächlich ausweichend wirken.

A website offers a filter labeled 'hide completed tasks'. When the user enables it, completed tasks disappear and the total counter also decreases. Why might this confuse users, and how could the interface distinguish the counts?

The filter changes the visible subset, not necessarily the underlying number of tasks. A single unlabeled count can make users think tasks were deleted. Show both figures with meaningful labels, for example “7 visible of 19 tasks” or separate remaining and completed counts. If the count is intended to describe only the current search results, say so and update it consistently. Filtering, deleting and changing task status should have distinguishable effects in the interface and data model.

I'm helping organize a local history tour. One volunteer knows a great deal and answers every visitor question, even those another guide is assigned to handle. How can we share the speaking time without rejecting their expertise?

Agree on clear roles before the tour: which guide leads each stop, who handles follow-up questions, and when another person may add a point. Speak with the knowledgeable volunteer privately and explain that the aim is to give each guide a chance to develop and let visitors follow a coherent narrative. Invite them to prepare a designated question session or act as a resource when a guide requests help. Expertise can strengthen the group without making every exchange depend on one voice.
「資料を見せてもらった」と「資料を見せてあげた」では、資料を見たのは誰ですか。話し手を基準に説明してください。
話し手が主語である場合、「資料を見せてもらった」は誰かが話し手に資料を見せてくれたという意味で、話し手が資料を見る側です。「資料を見せてあげた」は話し手が相手に資料を見せる側です。「もらう」と「あげる」は行為を受ける側と与える側の視点を表します。ただし「あげる」は相手や文脈によって恩着せがましく聞こえることもあり、単に「資料を見せた」で十分な場合があります。
Write a one-sentence alternative to a historical plaque's phrase 'Nothing of importance happened here after the factory closed.' Avoid inventing later events.
The factory's documented operations ended here, but the history of the site after its closure is less fully recorded.

Write a short fictional diary entry from the point of view of a lighthouse keeper whose lamp is working perfectly but who cannot see the shore through fog. The entry should distinguish what the keeper knows from what they imagine.

The lamp turned on schedule tonight. I checked the mechanism twice and heard its familiar rhythm, but the fog began at the foot of the tower and swallowed the shore. I imagined the houses lighting their windows one by one. Whether anyone was looking toward us, I cannot say. I will enter the weather in the log and leave the rest to morning.
There are six people at a small gathering, and every pair shakes hands exactly once. How many handshakes occur? Explain why multiplying six by five is not the final answer.

Each person shakes hands with five others, giving 6 times 5 = 30 person-handshake incidences. But a handshake between Ana and Ben is counted once for Ana and once for Ben, so divide by two. There are 15 unordered pairs, hence 15 handshakes. More generally, n people who each shake hands with every other person exactly once produce n(n-1)/2 handshakes.
A JavaScript application calls a sorting function on an array that is also used by another view. The other view unexpectedly changes order. How should the developer isolate the operation?

JavaScript's `Array.prototype.sort()` mutates the array in place, so other references to the array see the new order. Sort a shallow copy, such as `[...items].sort(compareFn)`, or use `items.toSorted(compareFn)` where supported. If the elements themselves are mutable objects, the copy still references the same objects. Sorting a copy isolates the order of the container, not arbitrary changes to its contents; use deeper isolation only where the data model requires it.

My friend is proud of finishing a lengthy online course and asks me to call them an expert in the subject. I want to celebrate their effort without making an assessment I cannot support. What could I say?

Celebrate the accomplishment you know about: “Finishing that course took real commitment. I'm excited to see what you do with everything you've learned.” If they ask whether they are now an expert, say that a completed course demonstrates participation or achievement according to its criteria, while expertise depends on the skills and experience relevant to the task. You can be enthusiastic about their progress without assigning a professional status you are not qualified to evaluate.
في وصف رحلة، ما الفرق بين «وصلنا قبل الموعد بعشر دقائق» و«وصلنا منذ عشر دقائق»؟

العبارة الأولى تقيس وقت الوصول بالنسبة إلى موعد محدد: إذا كان الموعد الساعة التاسعة، فقد وصلتم عند الثامنة وخمسين دقيقة. العبارة الثانية تقيس الزمن المنقضي منذ الوصول حتى لحظة الكلام: وصلتم قبل عشر دقائق من الآن. قد تصدقان معاً في موقف واحد، لكن لكل منهما نقطة مرجعية مختلفة. في جدول زمني، يُفضّل ذكر وقت الوصول الفعلي إذا كان معروفاً حتى لا يلتبس المرجع الزمني على القارئ.
Two clear liquids have the same refractive index at one wavelength, so an object immersed in either becomes similarly hard to see. Does this mean the liquids must have the same chemical composition?

No. Refractive index is a bulk optical property determined by how a material responds to light. Different compounds or mixtures can share the same index at a particular wavelength and temperature. They may differ in dispersion, density, viscosity, absorption or chemical behavior. A matching index can be useful for an optical experiment but is not a unique chemical fingerprint. Identification requires additional discriminating measurements or known composition records.

A furniture store has a policy of offering free delivery for purchases over $500. Its analyst divides delivery costs only by all customers, including those collecting their own orders. What other measure would help evaluate the policy itself?

Compute delivery cost per delivered order and examine the incremental cost of orders that qualify for the offer. Include distance, scheduling, labor, vehicle capacity and the proportion of qualifying customers who use delivery. Compare contribution margins and changes in purchasing behavior against a suitable baseline if assessing whether the offer pays for itself. Average delivery expense across every customer may describe overhead allocation, but it can hide the economics of the specific service.
A concert archive lists a composition under the date of its first published score, but letters suggest it was performed earlier in private. What dates should a catalog make available?

Separate composition, documented private performance, public premiere if known, and publication. For each event, attach the relevant source and its certainty. A publication date can often be verified bibliographically, while a letter might establish that a performance occurred or was merely planned. Do not choose one date to represent the whole work's history unless the field is explicitly defined. A timeline lets users see why different reference books may legitimately give different dates.
“회의를 앞두고 있습니다”와 “회의를 마치고 있습니다”는 각각 어떤 시점을 나타내나요?

“회의를 앞두고 있습니다”는 회의가 곧 열릴 예정이며 현재는 그 이전이라는 뜻입니다. “회의를 마치고 있습니다”는 회의를 끝내는 과정에 있음을 나타낼 수 있습니다. 이미 종료된 사실을 분명히 말하려면 “회의를 마쳤습니다”라고 쓰는 것이 자연스럽습니다. 일정 안내에서는 예정, 진행 중, 종료가 서로 다른 상태이므로 시간 표현을 상황에 맞게 선택하는 것이 중요합니다.

A bridge's temperature sensors report 10 degrees Celsius on one end and 22 degrees Celsius on the other. For a simplified linear temperature gradient along its 48 m deck, use a calculator to find the gradient in degrees per meter and the estimated temperature 18 m from the cooler end.

The modeled temperature increases by 12 degrees across 48 m, giving a gradient of 0.25 degrees Celsius per meter. At 18 m from the cooler end, the linear estimate is 10+18(0.25)=14.5 degrees Celsius. This is interpolation under the stated linear model, not a measured temperature at that position. Real thermal gradients can be nonlinear because of shade, wind and structural differences.

Write a three-sentence message to a small class announcing that the instructor will arrive 15 minutes late. Provide a useful activity that can be done independently, without implying students must remain unattended in an unsafe environment.

I'll be about 15 minutes late today. If the usual room is open and you are able to wait there safely, you can spend the time reviewing your notes and writing down one question from last week's lesson. If the room is closed, please follow the venue's normal waiting arrangements until I arrive.
“你看着办吧”在中文里可能是什么意思？我收到同事这样回复，但涉及一笔需要批准的支出。

An employee's personal phone has a work calendar synchronized to it. The phone is lost, and the calendar includes meeting locations and confidential titles. What response should focus on the actual data exposure?

Notify the organization's designated security or IT contact and follow the device-loss procedure. Determine whether the calendar was cached locally, what lock and encryption protections were enabled, and whether active work sessions can be revoked. Use authorized remote management measures if available; avoid wiping unrelated personal data without appropriate authority. Review the sensitivity and time window of potentially exposed entries. Resetting a password can be helpful, but it does not necessarily remove cached calendar content.
A flexible plastic ruler makes a sound when it is clamped at one end and plucked. Shortening its freely vibrating portion changes the pitch. What physical relationship explains the observation?

The protruding portion acts approximately as a cantilever beam. For comparable material and cross-section, its natural bending frequencies rise as the free length decreases; in a simple uniform beam model the fundamental frequency scales roughly as one over length squared. Shorter beams are effectively stiffer relative to their vibrating mass. Clamp quality and large deflections can affect the exact result. This is a bending vibration, so the formula for an ideal taut string is not the appropriate starting model.

I coordinate a volunteer proofreading group and one person prefers correcting spelling while another enjoys reviewing structure. Their work has been assigned interchangeably, and both are frustrated. How can I redesign the process?

Separate the stages and name the deliverable for each. Have structural review happen before copyediting when possible, since moving or rewriting passages can invalidate earlier corrections. Ask each volunteer which work they want to take and provide a common handoff checklist. A final proofreader can check the resulting version without reopening settled structural decisions unless something serious is found. Assignments should reflect skills, preferences and availability rather than treating every kind of editing as the same task.
Nella frase «Non vedo l'ora che arrivi sabato», il parlante ha difficoltà a leggere l'orologio? Spiegami l'espressione e il modo verbale.

No. «Non vedere l'ora» è un'espressione idiomatica che indica attesa impaziente o grande desiderio che qualcosa avvenga. In «Non vedo l'ora che arrivi sabato», il congiuntivo «arrivi» segue la costruzione con «che» e presenta l'evento desiderato. Se il soggetto delle due azioni è lo stesso, è comune l'infinito: «Non vedo l'ora di partire». Non si tratta di una difficoltà visiva né di un'indicazione dell'ora esatta.

A batch processor receives a file with 1,000 records. When record 700 is invalid, the first 699 have already been written to a database. Should the program necessarily erase them before returning an error?

It depends on the import's atomicity contract. If the entire file is one transaction, any invalid record should prevent committing all changes. If partial success is supported, preserve valid records, report rejected records clearly, and provide a retry mechanism that does not insert duplicates. Decide which behavior users need before implementing it, and make progress and final status reflect the chosen model. Returning only a generic error after partial writes leaves the caller unable to know what actually succeeded.
A square garden is divided into sixteen equal square plots in a 4-by-4 grid. How many of the plots touch the outer boundary, and how can you count without double-counting corners?

There are sixteen plots in total. Removing the outermost row and column from each side leaves a 2-by-2 interior grid of four plots, so twelve plots touch the boundary. Alternatively, count the four in the top row and four in the bottom row, then add the two noncorner plots on each side: 4+4+2+2=12. Counting four full sides would count each corner twice.
Em português, por que “fiquei de enviar o arquivo” não significa que o arquivo já foi enviado? Qual frase registra o envio de fato?

“Ficar de fazer algo” é uma construção que expressa uma combinação ou compromisso de realizar a ação. “Fiquei de enviar o arquivo” informa que você assumiu essa tarefa, mas não confirma sua execução. Para registrar o envio, escreva “Enviei o arquivo às 14h”. Se a confirmação de recebimento for importante, mantenha-a separada: “Enviei o arquivo e aguardo confirmação de recebimento”. Assim, compromisso, envio e recebimento não se confundem.

An editor preparing a collection of historical speeches encounters a speech manuscript with two alternative endings, neither crossed out. No recording survives. How should the edition present the ending?

Transcribe both alternatives, preserve their positions and any relevant manuscript markings, and explain that the surviving document does not establish which ending was delivered. The main text might present them as Version A and Version B or reproduce the manuscript's layout, depending on the edition's purpose. If a contemporary report mentions a distinctive phrase from one ending, cite it as additional evidence. Avoid creating a composite conclusion that neither the manuscript nor a performance source attests.
A detector reports no signal above its threshold when analyzing a sample. A report states that the target material is entirely absent. What alternative wording conveys the actual measurement?

State that the target was not detected above the specified threshold under the measurement conditions. A nondetection does not establish that its concentration is exactly zero; it may be below the method's sensitivity or affected by sample preparation or interference. Report the method, threshold or detection limit, units and any quality-control results. If an upper bound is justified by the validated method, state it separately rather than treating the instrument's inability to detect as absolute absence.

print(v)

Фраза «сделать к понедельнику» означает обязательно завершить работу в понедельник или можно раньше? Как обозначить срок без двусмысленности?

«К понедельнику» обычно обозначает срок, к которому работа должна быть готова, поэтому её можно закончить раньше. Однако время в пределах понедельника иногда понимают по-разному. Если это важно, напишите конкретно: «Передайте готовый документ не позднее 10:00 понедельника, 17 мая». Для выполнения именно в этот день лучше сказать «Выполните работу в понедельник». Указание даты и времени помогает отделить срок готовности от дня выполнения.

Write a fictional announcement from a town council introducing a trial of car-free mornings in the central square. Make it clear the trial is being evaluated, not already permanent. No invented dates.

The council will trial car-free mornings in the central square to assess how the space can serve pedestrians, local businesses and people traveling through the town center. The arrangement is temporary. During the trial we will collect feedback and review access, deliveries and traffic effects before deciding whether to continue, change or end it. Details of the operating times and access arrangements will be published separately.
A rotating electric fan appears to turn backward when filmed at certain frame rates. The fan itself has not changed direction. How can sampling produce that effect?

A camera records discrete frames rather than continuous motion. If identical blades rotate far enough between frames, each recorded position may look closer to a blade's preceding position in the opposite direction than to its actual forward position. The visual reconstruction can therefore alias fast forward rotation into slower apparent backward motion, or make it look stationary. A higher frame rate, shorter exposure and an asymmetrical blade marker can help distinguish the true motion from the sampled appearance.

I am part of a shared workshop with a friend who wants to reorganize all the storage shelves according to their personal system. Their system may be excellent, but several other members use the space. What is a fair trial?

Start with one shelf or category whose users agree to participate. Record the current arrangement and create visible labels so members can find tools during the trial. Agree on how long to test it and what would count as improvement, such as faster retrieval, easier returns or fewer misplaced items. Invite feedback from people who use the space differently before extending the system. A shared workspace needs a usable common arrangement, not necessarily the one that is most intuitive to its designer.
“Chưa chắc” có giống “chắc chắn không” không? Tôi muốn giải thích sự khác nhau khi nói về dự báo trời mưa.

Không giống nhau. “Chưa chắc trời mưa” nghĩa là việc trời mưa vẫn chưa được xác định chắc chắn; trời có thể mưa hoặc không. “Chắc chắn không mưa” lại khẳng định với độ tin tưởng cao rằng mưa sẽ không xảy ra. Nếu dự báo chỉ cho thấy khả năng thấp, bạn có thể nói “Khả năng mưa thấp, nhưng vẫn có thể mưa”. Đừng biến sự thiếu chắc chắn về một khả năng thành sự chắc chắn rằng khả năng đó không xảy ra.
A shop changes its packaging to use half as much material per order. During the same period the number of orders triples. Why might its total packaging material use rise despite improved efficiency?

If material per order falls to 0.5 of its former amount and the number of orders rises to three times its former count, total material use becomes 0.5 times 3 = 1.5 of the old total. That is a 50% increase, despite a 50% decrease per order. Track both intensity and aggregate consumption. Efficiency measures resource use relative to output, while total environmental burden also depends on the volume of activity and the rest of the material lifecycle.

A web interface displays user-entered text by assigning it directly to an element's `innerHTML`. It needs only to show plain text, including angle brackets. What safer rendering choice fits that requirement?

Assign the value to `textContent` rather than `innerHTML`. That creates text instead of asking the browser to parse the input as markup, so literal angle brackets remain visible and user-provided HTML does not become executable DOM content through that assignment. If the product genuinely needs a subset of formatted markup, use an appropriate vetted sanitization strategy for that context. Avoid relying on ad hoc character replacement when a text-only API already expresses the intended behavior.
Wat betekent “ik kom er nog op terug” na een vraag tijdens een vergadering? Is een specifiek antwoordmoment al vastgelegd?

De spreker geeft aan het onderwerp later opnieuw te behandelen of alsnog een antwoord te geven. De formulering legt geen precieze datum of tijd vast. Als de vraag gevolgen heeft voor een beslissing, maak dan een concretere afspraak: “Ik zoek dit uit en kom er uiterlijk woensdag op terug.” Daarmee blijft de belofte beperkt tot een terugkoppeling; het zegt nog niet dat het uiteindelijke antwoord positief zal zijn.
A person says that because 1/6 is less than 1/4, adding 1/6 to 1/4 must produce a number between the two. Explain the misconception and calculate the sum.

Adding a positive number increases the original quantity, so the sum must exceed each positive addend. Being between the two is a property of their arithmetic mean, not their sum. With common denominator 12, 1/6+1/4=2/12+3/12=5/12. That is larger than 3/12, which is 1/4. Their mean would instead be 5/24, which is between 1/6=4/24 and 1/4=6/24.

Om någon skriver ”ta inte illa upp”, betyder det att nästa mening alltid är en förolämpning? Hur kan man ge saklig återkoppling i stället?

Nej, uttrycket är en uppmaning att inte uppfatta något som personligt sårande. Det kan föregå en invändning eller kritik, men garanterar inte att det som följer är förolämpande eller välformulerat. Ofta är det bättre att beskriva den konkreta saken direkt: ”Jag har en synpunkt på dispositionen. A glass window reflects part of the light from a brightly lit room at night, making the view outside hard to see. During the day the outside is clearly visible. Has the glass become less transparent at night?

Not necessarily. The glass can transmit and reflect similar fractions of light in both situations. At night, outside objects send relatively little light toward the viewer, while bright indoor objects produce strong reflections at the glass surfaces. Those reflections dominate the view. During the day, brighter transmitted outdoor light can overwhelm the reflection. Reducing indoor illumination or shielding the glass from indoor reflections can improve visibility without changing the glass itself.
My neighbor asks me to recommend their new home bakery to everyone I know. I have enjoyed one product but have not tried the rest. How can I make an honest recommendation?

Recommend only what you have experienced and clearly identify the relationship if relevant. “I tried their lemon cake and really enjoyed it. They also offer other baked goods, though I haven't sampled those yet.” You can share the business's public menu if people want to explore it without claiming every product is excellent or guaranteeing service outcomes. Supporting someone's new business does not require taking responsibility for claims you cannot verify.
“Benim haberim olmadan” ifadesi ile “benim iznim olmadan” aynı şeyi mi söyler? Bir ortak karar hakkında yazıyorum.

Hayır. “Benim haberim olmadan” kararın alındığından veya işlemin yapıldığından haberdar edilmediğinizi anlatır. “Benim iznim olmadan” ise onayınızın alınmadığını vurgular. Bir işlemden haberdar olup izin vermemiş olabilirsiniz; tersine, önceden genel bir izin vermiş fakat belirli uygulamadan haberdar edilmemiş olabilirsiniz. Ortak karar konusunda hangi eksikliğin söz konusu olduğunu açıkça belirtmek, iletişim sorunuyla yetki sorununu birbirine karıştırmaz.

A workshop buys 8 identical tools for $52 each. The supplier refunds $6 for each of two defective tools and sends free replacements, with no other costs. Use a calculator to find the net total paid and the effective cost per usable tool after replacement.

The initial payment was $416. The two $6 refunds reduce it by $12, giving a net total of $404. Since the replacements restore the original order to eight usable tools, the effective cost is $50.50 per usable tool. The two defective items are not counted as additional usable tools, and the calculation assumes the replacements really are free of any further costs.
A cartographer finds a map printed with a scale bar, but the image has been stretched horizontally in a scanned textbook. Can the scale bar still be used for distances in every direction?

Not reliably. A horizontal scale bar may still describe horizontal distances in the distorted image if it was stretched with the map, but vertical and diagonal measurements can have different scale factors. Obtain an undistorted reproduction or use independently verified control points to correct the aspect ratio. Also check map projection and original scale limitations. A scale bar assumes a particular geometric relationship; nonuniform resizing breaks the assumption that one linear conversion applies equally in all directions.
Що означає «ледве чутно» в описі голосу? Чи можна замінити це на «нерозбірливо» без зміни сенсу?

«Ледве чутно» означає, що звук був дуже тихий і його важко було почути. «Нерозбірливо» означає, що складно розрізнити слова або їхній зміст; голос при цьому може бути й гучним. У свідченні краще зберегти конкретне спостереження: «Він говорив ледве чутно, але деякі слова можна було розібрати». Заміна одного вислову іншим може змінити опис акустичних умов або ступеня розуміння сказаного.
A researcher places a single temperature sensor beside the door of a greenhouse and reports its readings as the temperature experienced by every plant. How could spatial variation be assessed?

Deploy calibrated or cross-checked sensors at representative canopy heights and positions, including areas near the door, center, shaded sections and sunny edges. Record simultaneously so time-of-day changes are not mistaken for spatial differences. Protect sensors from direct radiation according to the measurement protocol and examine airflow and humidity where relevant. Summarize both typical conditions and extremes. The single sensor measures its local environment; treating it as representative of the entire greenhouse requires evidence.

An internal dashboard includes a button that downloads a spreadsheet of customer data. The download URL never expires and can be forwarded to other people without authentication. What change should be prioritized?

Require authorization when the file is requested rather than relying on possession of a permanent URL. Depending on the workflow, use authenticated downloads or narrowly scoped, short-lived signed links that can be revoked where possible. Ensure access is limited to the intended dataset and audience, and avoid placing reusable links in logs or public channels. Review existing exposed URLs and potential access according to the incident procedure. Expiration reduces exposure time but does not replace appropriate authorization.
Apa bedanya “saya sempat membaca laporan itu” dengan “saya belum sempat membaca laporan itu”? Apakah kalimat pertama berarti laporannya selesai dibaca?

“Saya sempat membaca laporan itu” berarti ada kesempatan untuk melakukan kegiatan membaca dan kegiatan itu terjadi, tetapi belum tentu seluruh laporan selesai dibaca. “Saya belum sempat membaca laporan itu” berarti sampai saat berbicara belum ada kesempatan yang digunakan untuk membacanya. Jika sudah selesai, katakan “Saya sudah membaca laporan itu sampai selesai”. Jika baru sebagian, sebutkan bagian yang telah dibaca agar orang lain tidak mengira peninjauan sudah lengkap.

Write a compact note for a group of volunteers whose outdoor event has been canceled because of weather. A new date is not decided. Avoid promising that every volunteer can attend the replacement date.

Today's outdoor event is canceled because of the weather. Thank you for setting aside your time and preparing to help. We haven't selected a new date yet; once we have one, we'll share it and ask who is available. Please don't feel obliged to commit again if the new schedule doesn't work for you.
A student argues that 0.999... must be smaller than 1 because every finite truncation is smaller than 1. Explain using limits why the infinite decimal equals 1.

The truncation after n nines equals 1-10^(-n), so every finite truncation is indeed less than 1. But the infinite decimal denotes the limit of these truncations, not one of them. The difference from 1 is 10^(-n), which tends to zero as n grows without bound. Therefore the limit is exactly 1. There is no final digit and no positive gap left over in the infinite representation, even though each finite approximation has a positive gap.
Mitä eroa on ilmauksilla ”kirja on loppu” ja ”kirja loppuu” silloin, kun puhutaan kirjakaupan saatavuudesta eikä tarinan juonesta?

Kirjakaupassa ”kirja on loppu” tarkoittaa yleensä, ettei kyseistä kirjaa ole enää varastossa tai myynnissä juuri nyt. ”Kirja loppuu” voi viitata siihen, että kirjan lukeminen tai tarina päättyy, tai asiayhteydestä riippuen siihen, että varasto on loppumassa. Asiakkaalle selkein ilmoitus olisi ”Kirja on tällä hetkellä loppu varastosta”. Jos uutta erää odotetaan, mainitse arvio erikseen äläkä lupaa saatavuutta ilman vahvistusta.
Write an original four-line poem in which a kitchen clock measures something other than time. No rhyme requirement, and don't use the word memory.

Its hands pass over the floury shelf,
counting the loaves that rose and fell.
At noon, a spoon knocks against a bowl;
the clock measures how much of a house is shared.
A monitoring system alerts when a service returns an HTTP status code other than 200. After enabling a cache, it begins alerting on 304 responses. What should its health criteria distinguish?

HTTP 304 Not Modified can be a successful conditional-request outcome: the client may reuse a cached representation rather than receive the body again. An exact-200 rule can therefore misclassify valid protocol behavior. Define the expected response set for each probe, including whether it sends conditional headers and whether a body is required. A service health check that must validate current content may use an unconditional request or verify cache semantics explicitly. Separate protocol success from application-specific health assertions.

I am helping a relative sort through boxes before moving. They want me to decide which sentimental objects they should discard because the decisions are tiring. How can I help while preserving their control?

Offer a process instead of taking over irreversible choices. Sort items into clear categories, such as obvious recycling, keep, donate if approved and undecided. Ask which low-stakes categories they want you to handle independently, then reserve sentimental items for short sessions when they have energy. You can photograph some items if they want a record. Do not discard something meaningful solely because the decision is difficult; reducing the number of decisions is useful without removing their authority over the objects.
Nataka kueleza tofauti kati ya “karibu kila siku” na “kila siku bila kukosa” katika taarifa ya mazoezi. Je, zote zinaonyesha siku zote?

Hapana. “Karibu kila siku” inaonyesha kwamba mazoezi yalifanyika siku nyingi, lakini si lazima kila siku. “Kila siku bila kukosa” inasisitiza kwamba hakuna siku iliyorukwa katika kipindi kinachozungumziwa. Ikiwa kumbukumbu inaonyesha mazoezi katika siku 26 kati ya 30, eleza idadi hiyo au tumia “karibu kila siku”. Usitumie kauli ya siku zote bila uthibitisho, kwa sababu inatoa dai lililo kamili zaidi kuliko data iliyopo.

A historical photograph shows a woman holding a hammer beside a partly built wooden structure. The image is used in a textbook as proof that she designed the building. How would you revise the caption and investigate the broader claim?

Describe what the photograph actually shows: a woman holding a hammer beside a structure under construction, adding verified names, location and date if available. The scene may suggest participation in construction or a posed depiction, but does not establish authorship of the design. Search for plans, signed drawings, contracts, correspondence and contemporary accounts to assess her role. The caption should acknowledge the visible evidence while leaving the design attribution open until supported by other sources.
